messages.content: I want to try the free plan, but it keeps asking for a credit card.
The free plan requires a card to verify your account.
Then forget it. I am not entering my card just to try this.
I entered my email but the verification link never arrives.
I checked. Nothing. This is the third attempt.
It says my organization already has an account and I need an invitation.
Your workspace administrator can invite you.
I am the administrator. I have never used this before.
The email link worked after I opened it in the same browser where I started. I am in now.
Please send a copy of last month's invoice.
Your invoice is in Settings under Billing.
Can I move my meeting to Friday?
Yes, your calendar is free at 2pm.
